build_login: build a login flow that authenticates a user to the Hugging Face Hub with a token and optional git credential storage
create_logout: create a logout flow that removes stored tokens and clears git credentials from the machine
test_auth_switch: test switching between stored access tokens by name and setting the active token
review_auth_list: review listing all stored access tokens with masked values and identifying the current active token
summarize_notebook_login: summarize the notebook-based login that displays an ipywidgets password prompt for token entry
